description: A side-by-side comparison table or small-multiples bar chart showing each approach scored on: upfront cost, annual maintenance, temperature reduction, and years to ROI. Use consistent color coding for the three approaches that carries through the rest of the document.

A Gantt-style timeline showing, for each approach, the phases from contract award to measurable temperature impact—spanning 0 to 60 months. Annotate with a vertical line at the next municipal election or budget review date if known.

A scenario matrix: rows are the three allocation strategies, columns are outcome dimensions (cost, speed, temperature impact, political risk, flexibility to adjust next cycle). Use a simple RAG (red/amber/green) rating per cell with a one-line rationale on hover.
A structured comparison table or small-multiple bar chart showing all three approaches scored across the five dimensions, with ranges shown where data varies by climate zone.

A two-axis priority matrix plot: x-axis is 'Speed of Impact' (short to long-term), y-axis is 'Cost per Degree of Cooling,' with each approach plotted as a labeled point and shaded zones indicating which quadrant matches which council priority profile.
A stacked bar or proportional area chart showing the three budget scenarios side by side, with segments color-coded by approach and annotated with projected cooling outcomes.
A radar/spider chart or color-coded matrix showing all three approaches scored across the five dimensions simultaneously.
A grouped bar chart showing projected temperature reduction and cost-per-resident for each of the three allocation scenarios over a 5-year window.
A 3-column comparison table or bubble chart with axes of upfront cost per km² and average temperature reduction, with bubble size representing annual maintenance burden.
A horizontal Gantt-style timeline showing 'first measurable effect,' 'partial impact,' and 'full impact' bands for each of the three approaches, spanning a 0–20 year horizon.

A small reference map or icon-grid showing comparable cities, each tagged with which approach(es) they used, budget committed, and a one-line outcome verdict (e.g., 'Achieved 1.8°C reduction over 8 years' or 'Stalled due to maintenance funding gap').

A three-column scorecard showing each scenario's budget split (as a stacked bar or pie), projected 10-year cooling impact, and a traffic-light risk rating across cost overrun, maintenance liability, and public visibility.
